class.name: TickTransport
class.brief_description: Base class of the transports used by [TickNetwork].
class.description: A transport moves bytes between peers. It identifies the sender of every packet from the connection, never from the packet's content, so a peer can't impersonate another one. See [EnetStarTransport] (a server and its clients), [EnetMeshTransport] (servers with fixed ids) and [EnetHostedMeshTransport] (players over the internet).

method.name: get_channel_count
method.description: Returns the number of channels available to the network.

method.name: get_local_peer_id
method.description: Returns the id of this peer. In a star, 1 is the server; in a mesh, every node has its own id.

method.name: get_max_payload_size
method.description: Returns the largest payload, in bytes, that fits in a single datagram without fragmentation.

method.name: poll
method.description: Sends the queued packets and receives the incoming ones. [TickNetwork] calls it every tick.
